title: SolarPunk Currency System Lab
thesis: Compress the currency-system path into one reproducible public-lab artifact without claiming mainnet adoption.

layers.name: Public lab primitive
layers.claim: Signed meter fixture data has produced a replay-protected SPK mint on Sepolia with public readback.

layers.name: Local field receipt loop
layers.claim: The accepted meter bundle now runs through a local end-to-end loop: SPK mint, invoice settlement, redemption burn, owed-kWh receipt, and delivery resolution.
layers.blocker_to_upgrade: Replace fixture meter data with one real meter or inverter export.

layers.name: Redeemable energy receipt framework
layers.claim: SPK can be transferred into SolarPunkCurrencySystem, burned through redeemForEnergy, and recorded as an owed-kWh receipt with fulfillment/shortfall/dispute states.
layers.blocker_to_upgrade: Deploy beside the attested SPK proof stack and bind to one real redemption operator.

layers.name: Networked settlement framework
layers.claim: SPK invoice settlement is implemented as a replay-protected payment router while the lab ledger models multi-party circulation and conservation.
layers.blocker_to_upgrade: Deploy and run one real invoice/counterparty settlement.

transactions.note: SPK minted from accepted surplus-energy attestation.
Producer pays the meter gateway for data service.
Producer pays maintenance provider in SPK.
Producer distributes SPK to a local buyer as an energy-credit settlement unit.
Buyer spends SPK with a local merchant.
Merchant settles an energy-credit invoice back to producer.
Buyer burns SPK against a lab-model energy-credit redemption.

claim_boundaries: Layer 2 is a deterministic local field-receipt loop, not a real external pilot.
Layers 3-4 now have local contract/test coverage, but no public deployment or real commercial adoption.
No token sale, mainnet readiness, yield, audit completion, or legal redemption claim is made.
The purpose is to move from local field receipt coherence to a real meter export loop.
